apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: online-boutique
---
# ==========================================
# REDIS (Cart Backend)
# ==========================================
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cart
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: online-boutique
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cart
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cart
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 999
        fsGroup: 999
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: redis
          image: redis:7.2-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 6379
              name: redis
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 70m
              memory: 100Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 125m
              memory: 256Mi
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 6379
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 15
          readinessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["redis-cli", "ping"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 15
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /data
              name: redis-data
      volumes:
        - name: redis-data
          emptyDir: {}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: redis-cart
  namespace: online-boutique
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis-cart
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: online-boutique
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 6379
      targetPort: 6379
      name: redis
  selector:
    app: redis-cart
---

        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: server
          image: gcr.io/google-samples/microservices-demo/adservice:v0.10.1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 9555
              name: grpc
          env:
            - name: PORT
              value: "9555"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 200m
              memory: 180Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 300Mi
          readinessProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 9555
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 15
          livenessProbe:
            grpc:
              port: 9555
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 15
